purpose: Primary grading assumption: a fresh script per address, timed externally from launch until complete console output.
limitations: Twenty seeded uniformly sampled cases per dataset, repeated over five rounds: 100 cold processes, not 100 unique cases.
Sampled mean and maximum do not certify the full dataset. Default benchmark mode covers every case.
Fresh interpreters and indexes; OS page caches and Python bytecode caches are uncontrolled.
Complete JSONL stdout is timestamped in the parent; reader scheduling overhead is included; process exit is measured separately.
Local CPython 3.14.4 and provisional CLI protocol; official runtime and protocol remain unverified.
Historical long-input probes are separate warmed diagnostics, not part of the cold sample.

measurement_contract.timer: parent perf_counter_ns immediately before Popen until the complete JSONL result line is read from stdout
measurement_contract.stdout: UTF-8 JSONL captured through an OS pipe; no prediction file or terminal rendering
measurement_contract.cold_definition: fresh interpreter and matcher for every address; no persistent index or prediction cache
measurement_contract.filesystem_cache: OS file/page caches and Python bytecode caches are uncontrolled; not a cold-machine measurement
measurement_contract.stdout_observer: parent reader thread timestamps complete lines; pipe/thread setup precedes timing; scheduling overhead is included
measurement_contract.process_exit: cold_process_exit separately records launch through communicate/wait; every CLI must exit successfully
measurement_contract.first_request: identify only, after index construction; diagnostic, excludes startup
measurement_contract.child_total_elapsed: diagnostic worker including case loading, warmups and report-file I/O; not grading latency
measurement_contract.batch: one process for the entire dataset; elapsed / case count is throughput, not maximum request latency

memory.measurement_notes: tracemalloc measures Python heap allocations; ru_maxrss measures OS peak resident set size and includes tracemalloc overhead.

thresholds.observation_note: Local observed cold-process limits only; sampled runs cannot certify full-dataset mean or maximum. Primary timing stops when the parent receives the complete result line; process exit is measured separately.
